what_changed: Same front on the axis. 1873: both storeys up to the parapet with crest, windows and shell fountain, birch and reeds in front. Today: only ground-floor piers on the base stand; upper storey and parapet gone; hedges; open ground.
note: Old is research-only (S770).

what_changed: Both on the axis from the south. 1873: niche with shell crest above its top, side wall and balustrade, 远瀛观 clock gate above, deep reeds. Today: niche arch and flanks stand, crest and the clock gate gone, ground bare, side wall gone.
note: Old is research-only (S770).

what_changed: Opposite obliques: 1873 from the north-east, today from the north-west. All five panels and pilasters stand both times; 1873 has cornice and crest pieces on top, grass and reeds to the steps. Today: top course gone, brick backing wall behind, curved steps and platform cleared.
note: Mirror angle; take as state, not view.

what_changed: South side both. 1873: full clock gate with crest and wheel, brick wall and doorway, carved columns set in wall. 2007: gate and walls all gone; four free columns and a lintel stand on low stones.
note: New is lower and closer.

what_changed: Same façade, nearly the same place, 1873 and 1876 (P0190 by file name). Cropped lower in P0190, so the clock crest is out of frame; walls, door and columns unchanged at this size.
note: Old-old pair. The credit of P0190 to Piry rests on the file name only (METHOD: prints credited to Piry may be by Moore).

what_changed: Both across the pool from the south. 1873: three-storey block standing beyond reeds. 2013: blocks and stumps, one pier in front, trees behind, no building above ground floor; pool iced and clear of reeds.

North side on the axis with the same scalloped basin in front. 1873: full north front with upper blocks, double stairs, two trees, basin broken. Today: front down to low block walls, trees and lamp posts; basin whole; whether repaired or rebuilt is not known.
note: Basin in both; the catalogue ties P0348 to CC28 too.

what_changed: South-west to south. 1873: three storeys, upper windows and stair with ramp. Today: only stair remnants and a column on the ground.
note: Oblique angle differs.

what_changed: East wing from the south. 1873: octagonal pavilion with roofless arches, curved colonnade to the block. 2013: column stumps and base, no colonnade, no pavilion storey.
East end, Ohlmer 1873 and Child (Commons 1877-78). Same building face and collapsed arcade at foot; Child frames tighter, with roofline balustrade full width. No large change at this size.
note: Old-old pair.

what_changed: East side. 1873: two storeys and parapet on the arcade. 2013: stacked blocks to about one storey, fallen pieces, trees behind.

Same axis towards the maze pavilion. 1873: 花园门 arch with iron fan-light, wall each side, two finial piers and the domed pavilion seen through it, four men seated. Now: no arch in any modern picture seen; the two piers and a rebuilt pavilion stand, visitors, smooth paving.
note: Whether the modern piers are the old ones is unknown.

what_changed: Both from the south-west. 1873: two storeys with tiled roof intact, double stair with carved balustrades, deep tree growth. Today: only piers rise from the base; roof, upper floor, stair balustrades and trees gone.
note: Old is research-only (S770).

what_changed: East gate frontal, Child 1870s and Sirén 1922?. 1870s: curved front with vases, balustrade and carved pilasters whole. Later: centre arch left in rough brick, facings stripped, blocks fallen in front.
note: Old-old pair. Both already in catalogue.

what_changed: 1870s: the gate standing. 2005: gate gone; half-round shells and blocks at ground level.

note: Both free; both opened.
